name: quick-settings-ng
description: Next-generation, modular Quick Settings customization for GNOME Shell.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run build:ts && npm run build:css && npm run build:schema && cp metadata.json LICENSE docs/UPSTREAM.md dist/
scripts.build:schema: mkdir -p dist/schemas && cp schemas/*.gschema.xml dist/schemas/ && glib-compile-schemas --strict --targetdir=dist/schemas dist/schemas
scripts.check: npm run audit:source && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run pack
